intro.title: Africa Gastronomique Botswana (AFGAB)
intro.text: Africa Gastronomique is a dynamic pan-African association of chefs, culinary professionals and passionate advocates of African cuisine. Its mission is to promote and elevate African gastronomy — with a particular focus on the richness of Botswana's culinary heritage — while transforming the perception of the restaurant and hospitality industries across the continent. Present in 26 African countries, the network preserves, modernises and celebrates the ancestral culinary arts of Africa.

intro.title: Who Are We?
intro.text: We are Africa Gastronomique, a dynamic pan-African association of chefs, culinary professionals, and passionate advocates of African cuisine. United by a shared vision, our mission is to promote and elevate African gastronomy with a particular focus on showcasing the richness of Botswana culinary heritage while transforming the perception of the restaurant and hospitality industries across the continent.

vision.text: To promote and elevate African gastronomy, showcasing Botswana's culinary heritage while transforming the perception of the restaurant and hospitality industries across the continent.

mission.title: Overall Objective
mission.text: To celebrate African gastronomy while building partnerships for sustainable growth, cultural preservation, and shared prosperity.

objectives.title: Specific Objectives
objectives.intro: FIGA Botswana 2026 contributes directly to Botswana's strategic development priorities by:
items: Promoting economic diversification through tourism, gastronomy and the creative economy
Supporting citizen economic empowerment through SME participation and entrepreneurship
Creating employment and skills development opportunities for young people
Promoting local procurement and value addition within the agrifood sector
Positioning Botswana as a preferred destination for Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE)
Strengthening regional integration and intra-African trade under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA)
Advancing sustainable food systems through the promotion of indigenous foods and responsible sourcing

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.text: Africa Gastronomique Botswana is led by Chef Monana Motswaledi, President of the association. The Africa Gastronomique Organisation was founded by Chef Joseph Lancma of Cameroon.

network.title: A Growing Pan-African Network
network.text: Present in 26 African countries, our network is growing rapidly, bringing together diverse talents and traditions under one shared goal: to preserve, modernize, and celebrate the ancestral culinary arts of Africa. Through education, capacity-building, and cultural celebration, we empower chefs, culinary students, and food entrepreneurs via:
items: Awareness campaigns on food safety and traditional knowledge
Research and documentation of indigenous food practices

background.title: Background
paragraphs: Over the past decade, gastronomy has emerged as a powerful catalyst for tourism development, cultural preservation, economic diversification, and social inclusion across Africa and the world. Governments, development agencies, tourism authorities, and private sector stakeholders increasingly recognize food as a strategic asset capable of creating jobs, stimulating local economies, strengthening value chains, and promoting national identity on the global stage.

The International Forum of African Gastronomy (FIGA) has been at the forefront of this agenda, creating platforms that celebrate Africa's rich culinary heritage while fostering innovation, professional development, and cross-border collaboration.

Building on this momentum, FIGA Botswana 2026 will create opportunities for knowledge exchange, investment, tourism promotion, and cultural diplomacy, bringing together chefs, hospitality professionals, policymakers, investors, educators, producers, development partners, and cultural practitioners from Africa and beyond.

conclusion.title: More Than an Event
conclusion.text: FIGA Botswana 2026 is a strategic platform for economic transformation, tourism growth, cultural diplomacy, and skills development. By bringing together government, industry, investors, chefs, entrepreneurs, and development partners, the forum will position Botswana as Africa's premier destination where gastronomy, tourism, culture, and business converge — leaving a legacy of strengthened partnerships, empowered entrepreneurs, enhanced destination competitiveness, and sustainable economic opportunities for communities across Botswana.

hero.title: Driving Tourism, Culture, Food Security and Economic Development

heritage.title: Botswana's Culinary Heritage
heritage.text: Botswana is home to a rich and diverse culinary heritage rooted in indigenous ingredients, traditional food systems, and the cultural identities of its many communities. From premium Botswana beef and sorghum to wild foods, traditional beverages, and regional culinary traditions, Botswana possesses authentic food experiences capable of complementing its world-renowned wildlife and cultural tourism products.

traditional.title: Why Botswana
traditional.text: Globally recognised for its political stability, conservation leadership, premium tourism offerings, and sound economic governance, Botswana is well positioned to become a leading destination for gastronomy and culinary tourism. FIGA Botswana 2026 will showcase gastronomy as an integral component of the visitor experience — contributing to destination diversification, increased visitor spending, rural enterprise development, and the promotion of Botswana's cultural identity.

ingredients.title: Africa on the World Stage
ingredients.text: While global gastronomy continues to evolve and gain recognition, African cuisine remains underrepresented on the world stage, despite its diversity, depth, and ancestral richness. Africa Gastronomique is undertaking a bold initiative to elevate and professionalize African gastronomy — particularly Botswana cuisine — through education, innovation, and cultural celebration.

initiatives.title: A Catalyst for Development
initiatives.text: Gastronomy creates jobs, stimulates local economies, strengthens value chains, and promotes national identity. Through conferences, masterclasses, competitions, exhibitions, B2B engagements, cultural showcases, and investment dialogues, the forum will support economic diversification, local enterprises, job creation, and stronger food systems.

endorsement.title: Endorsed by the Botswana Tourism Organisation
endorsement.text: In a letter dated 12 August 2026 (Ref. BTO 1/2/5/2), signed by Justice Ofentse, Acting Chief Executive Officer, BTO endorsed the First International Gastronomy and Culinary Arts (FIGA) Botswana 2026 and committed to in-kind assistance and publicity support. This includes promotion through BTO's communication and marketing platforms, sharing event information through its digital channels and stakeholder networks, technical guidance on tourism-related aspects, and facilitation of linkages with tourism stakeholders and industry partners.
